crossRefs.note: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons…

people.name: Enosh
people.line: Son of Seth, during whose time people called on the Lord's name.

people.name: Kenan
people.line: Son of Enosh, descendant of Seth

translations.web: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
translations.asv: and Enosh lived after he begat Kenan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
